statusDetail: All 58 catalog checks have conclusive outcomes. Representative non-home routes were intermittently intercepted by Cloudflare; those observed failures are judged as site resilience/discoverability issues rather than omitted audit work.

page.notes: Public adult-story content site. Homepage is server-rendered. Initial use is obscured by a third-party AgeVerif layer. Cloudflare intermittently challenged deeper routes. Coverage included home, article, category, submission, search and error archetypes; video playback, account/payment routes and every taxonomy were excluded because they are separate or duplicate templates.

paths.description: Homepage and latest-story listing, including the on-load age-verification journey; represents the global shell, navigation, search, listing cards and advertising.
Representative story/detail URL selected from the homepage. It represents long-form content and article indexing. Cloudflare intermittently returned its challenge instead of the article.
Couple category selected as the representative taxonomy/listing template; mobile capture was attempted and received the Cloudflare challenge.
Submit Story is the primary contribution/form journey; Lighthouse and mobile probes were run, but a later browser probe received the Cloudflare challenge.
Search results for “love” exercise the site-search journey and results template; the capture encountered the global verification/challenge layer.
A deliberately missing route exercised the HTTP failure/recovery experience; it was intercepted by the Cloudflare challenge.

findings.summary: The age-verification interstitial obscures all content on every initial visit.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots show a full-viewport dimming layer and centered third-party AgeVerif card before any site content can be used; no visible dismiss or alternative is offered.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep age assurance proportionate and first-party, explain why it is required, provide an accessible exit, and avoid re-showing it after a valid decision. Use a semantic dialog with platform focus management and light-dismiss only where legally appropriate.

findings.summary: The verification and Cloudflare layers prevent predictable completion of reading, search, and submission journeys.
findings.evidence: The homepage is hidden by AgeVerif, while representative article, category, submission and error probes intermittently received “Just a moment…” instead of their intended templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Make bot protection and age assurance fail safely: preserve readable content where permitted, persist completed verification, and ensure real users can reach article, search and submission paths without challenge loops.

findings.summary: The authored site does not adapt to the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: With prefers-color-scheme: dark matched, the body remained rgb(247,248,249) with rgb(34,34,34) text and computed color-scheme “normal”.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and define surface/text tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark(), including the verification UI.

findings.summary: Navigation and state changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: The platform probe and rendered source found no view-transition declaration or API use on this multi-page content site.
findings.suggestedFix: Add cross-document View Transitions for article/list navigation with a Baseline-compatible fallback, and suppress non-essential transitions for reduced motion.

findings.summary: Reusable components rely on viewport styling rather than container queries.
findings.evidence: The live CSS probe found no @container rule while listing/navigation components are reused across content and sidebar contexts.
findings.suggestedFix: Define containment for reusable cards/navigation groups and use size container queries for local layout changes, retaining viewport fallbacks.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint is slow on key paths.
findings.evidence: Trace measured homepage LCP at 3.78s; Lighthouse measured 3.3s on home and 4.3s on Submit Story, both above the 2.5s good threshold.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the true LCP element, shorten render-blocking chains, delay non-essential third parties, and verify LCP under representative mobile conditions.

findings.summary: Render-blocking and cache policy delay primary content.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 1.01s render-blocking savings and 67KiB cache-lifetime savings; HAR records 40 requests and multiple slow scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical CSS, defer non-critical scripts, set useful immutable cache lifetimes for versioned assets, and review each dependency in the critical chain.

findings.summary: The page ships avoidable unused and unminified code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 92KiB unused JavaScript, 34KiB unused CSS, and 39KiB unminified JavaScript on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused plugins and ad integrations, split route-specific code, minify production bundles, and load optional dependencies only after intent.

findings.summary: Interactive and embedded content has incomplete accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed iframe-title, link-name and visible-label/accessibility-name matching on home, and iframe-title plus unlabeled select on Submit Story.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every iframe a descriptive title, remove empty links, align visible labels with accessible names, and associate each select/input with a persistent label.

findings.summary: Text and control colors fail minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse color-contrast failed on both the homepage and Submit Story archetypes.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace failing color tokens with combinations meeting WCAG AA in all states and verify light, dark and forced-color conditions.

findings.summary: Heading and accessibility-tree structure is inconsistent.
findings.evidence: Homepage DOM contains an empty H1 followed by story H2s; Submit Story Lighthouse failed heading order, and both Lighthouse runs reported the agent accessibility tree was not well formed.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one descriptive H1 per page, keep heading levels sequential, preserve landmarks, and retest keyboard and accessibility-tree order.

findings.summary: Third-party code uses deprecated browser APIs and prevents clean platform behavior.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported three deprecation warnings, inspector issues, and two BFCache failure reasons on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove or replace dependencies using deprecated storage/advertising APIs, resolve DevTools issues, and eliminate unload/BFCache blockers.

findings.guidanceId: crawlable links viewport meta robots descriptive link text
findings.summary: Representative article URLs are intermittently served as HTTP 403 challenge pages to crawler-like clients.
findings.evidence: Discoverability fetch of the selected article returned 403 with 0% content coverage while the homepage returned 200 with 96% coverage.
findings.suggestedFix: Tune Cloudflare bot rules so permitted search and AI crawlers receive the canonical article HTML, and validate sitemap URLs with crawler user agents.

findings.summary: CSP is missing and one long-lived cookie lacks Secure.
findings.evidence: Headers inspection found no Content-Security-Policy or Referrer-Policy. Cookie inspection found naslvq set for 365 days with Secure=false, HttpOnly=false and SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP, set a strict Referrer-Policy, and make every SameSite=None cookie Secure; shorten and harden non-essential cookie lifetime.

findings.summary: The homepage exposes users to an excessive third-party advertising and tracking surface.
findings.evidence: Tracker/network probes observed 15 third-party origins, including ad, push, age-verification, Disqus and analytics hosts; several third-party requests failed or were blocked.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove non-essential partners, require explicit informed consent before optional third-party loading, proxy or self-host essential assets, and document retention and purpose.

findings.guidanceId: http error network failure timeout retry stale data resilient state
findings.summary: Failure states collapse into generic challenge pages with no site-specific recovery.
findings.evidence: Representative article and missing-route probes displayed Cloudflare “Just a moment…” pages; the article crawler fetch returned 403 and the intended 404 recovery template could not be reached.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide branded 404/429/challenge recovery with retry and contact paths, and configure edge protection to avoid challenging normal navigations and legitimate crawlers.

findings.summary: The multilingual-content site is not writing-mode resilient.
findings.evidence: The page declares en-US, but live CSS contained zero logical-property matches and 31 physical left/padding-left rules despite serving English and romanized Hindi content.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark content language changes where appropriate and replace physical spacing/positioning with inline/block logical properties; verify RTL and translated layouts.

findings.summary: The contribution form has accessibility defects that undermine humane error recovery.
findings.evidence: Submit Story Lighthouse failed select-name and heading-order, so error context and controls are not consistently identified to assistive technology.
findings.suggestedFix: Associate labels and descriptions with every field, validate after interaction, focus an error summary on submit, and announce errors via a live region.

findings.guidanceId: honest defaults no dark patterns confirmshaming forced continuity consent
findings.summary: Advertising is presented as ordinary primary navigation.
findings.evidence: Homepage DOM lists “Live Cams” and “AI Porn Video” alongside site navigation but their URLs redirect to unrelated advertising/affiliate domains with no ad disclosure.
findings.suggestedFix: Clearly label sponsored/affiliate destinations, separate them from first-party navigation, show destination context, and avoid misleading redirect chains.

findings.summary: The logo uses legacy, non-responsive image delivery.
findings.evidence: Images probe found the only img is PNG with no srcset; Lighthouse estimated 7KiB image-delivery savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve an SVG or AVIF/WebP alternative where appropriate and provide responsive sources while retaining intrinsic dimensions.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts are disproportionate to a text-first page.
findings.evidence: HAR records 216.8KB of script transfer and tracker inspection found 15 third-party origins on a primarily text-content homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a strict third-party byte/request budget, remove low-value ad/push vendors, and defer remaining integrations until user intent or consent.

taskList.title: Remove challenge/gate loops from core reading and submission journeys
Reduce and consent-gate the third-party advertising/tracking surface
Make the verification experience semantic, accessible and non-obscuring
Fix CSP, Referrer-Policy and cookie attributes
Bring LCP into the good range and shorten critical resource chains
Repair contrast, names, labels and heading structure
Adopt logical CSS and language-aware markup
Replace deprecated APIs and restore BFCache eligibility
